title: On the Intracoastal Watersports & Pontoon Boats
specs: Opportunity to see wildlife such as manatees, dolphins, sea turtles, spotted eagle rays, and horseshoe crabs
All participants must sign a Watersports Waiver
Participants under 18 must have waivers signed by a parent or court-appointed guardian
Children under 18 are welcome to paddle their own boat if accompanied by an adult
includes: Life jackets and paddles included with all rentals
gap: Exact group size capacity for pontoon boats not stated
blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats, kayaks, or stand-up paddleboards to explore the Intracoastal Waterway and surrounding waterways in Pompano Beach. Rentals include equipment and safety gear. The company offers a family-friendly, eco-friendly experience with opportunities to see local wildlife.
extraNote: Renters must return by 6:00 pm · Located in Club Wyndham Santa Barbara, 1301 S Ocean Blvd, Pompano Beach, FL 33062
